body: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW original fictional Foxglove Z 2003 compact front-engine two-seat fastback sports coupe for a 2994 abandoned-world racing game. Reference image ONLY for painterly worn salvage materials, eight-view sprite-sheet layout and transparent wheel openings, NOT its sedan body design. Distinct short rounded fastback coupe, long low hood, arched cabin, thick rear haunches, short rear deck, single door each side. Worn deep petrol blue paint with muted copper repair panels, paired compact angular halogen headlights and simple round inset rear lamps, no logos, badges, lettering or manufacturer-specific shapes. Exactly eight separate full vehicle body sprites in 4 columns x2 rows on wide 3:1 transparent canvas. Top row: straight front; front three-quarter nose pointing LEFT; full side nose LEFT; rear three-quarter nose RIGHT. Bottom row: straight rear; rear three-quarter nose LEFT; full side nose RIGHT; front three-quarter nose RIGHT. Consistent same coupe every view. NO tires, wheels, rims, black backing or suspension in wheel arches: wheel openings must be fully transparent cutouts open to bottom, runtime supplies wheels. All silhouettes isolated with margin, never overlap/crop. Ground-level fixed rear game camera style, crisp illustrative details, no shadows outside body, no scenery. Preserve genuine transparent background and clean edges.
dashboard: Use case: stylized-concept. Create an ORIGINAL Foxglove Z2003 sports coupe left-hand-drive dashboard game overlay. Reference is ONLY worn painterly 2994 salvage texture and transparency structure, not its design. Wide 2.5:1 canvas. Deep charcoal curved driver-focused dashboard with aged petrol-blue and copper repair trim, three small central round air vents, upright narrow center control console, broad passenger glovebox. A LARGE completely BLANK opaque black driver instrument binnacle at LEFT x210..790,y430..680 on1983x793 canvas for runtime gauges. No painted gauges/dials/numbers/text in this blank area. Absolutely NO steering wheel, steering column, hands, logos or text anywhere. No windshield scenery. All area above dash genuinely transparent, only thin windshield posts at far edges, no roof across top. Straight-on driver's camera view, dash lower half, clean transparent edges. Fictional distinct design, not real manufacturer dashboard. Runtime supplies shared steering wheel and gauges.
